=== Lead photograph (31 Oct 2026) ===
The lead is a crop of the left-hand man in a Facebook Highlights Featured photograph on facebook.com/josh.koziura. Exact legal name already on the wiki plus membership in the Star Wars CCG Facebook group (added by Chris Schoenthal 26 September 2013). Gold 105 Nashville. A Greedo circular is not the person lead. Dest the crop of Josh; the uncropped two-person original stays in Photographs. Wiki File is the dest JPEG of the photograph. The File page Preserved copy is the Facebook profile screenshot. Identification stays on Talk. See [[:File:Josh Koziura portrait.jpg]] and [[:File:Josh Koziura Facebook portrait.jpg]].
